meta.name: gemini
meta.description: Cross-model second opinion from Google Gemini — a different AI reviewing the same changes, with deep Google ecosystem knowledge. Three modes: review (pass/fail gate for Google Ads campaigns, SEO metadata, or code), challenge (adversarial stress-test that tries to break your changes), and consult (open Q&A with Gemini on Google Ads strategy, SEO best practices, or implementation questions). Use when the user says "gemini review", "ask gemini", "gemini challenge", "second opinion from gemini", "consult gemini", "stress test with gemini", "what would gemini say", "cross-model review", or "get another opinion". Voice aliases: "gem", "gemini check". Especially useful for Google Ads changes, SEO metadata updates, campaign structure decisions, keyword strategies, and bid/budget changes — Gemini has native Google ecosystem knowledge that complements Claude's analysis.

howto.what: Claude 会启动 Gemini CLI,让另一个 AI 独立审查你的 Google Ads、SEO 或代码改动,并汇报结论。有三种模式:审查(过/不过)、挑战(压力测试)、咨询(问答)。
howto.when: 当你说“gemini review”、“ask gemini”、“gemini challenge”等关键词,或要求 Gemini 给出第二意见时触发。尤其适用于 Google Ads 改动、SEO 元数据和代码变更的审查。

say.text: 用 gemini review 看看这批 Google Ads 关键词改动
say.note: 触发审查模式,让 Gemini 给出过/不过结论。

say.text: 用 gemini challenge 测测这个 SEO 标题改动有没有漏洞

say.text: ask gemini 咨询一下 Google Ads 预算怎么分配
say.note: 触发咨询模式,获得 Gemini 的建议。

howto.what_en: Claude launches the Gemini CLI, letting another AI independently review your Google Ads, SEO, or code changes and report its verdict, warnings, strengths. Modes: review (pass/fail), challenge (stress test), consult (Q&A).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says phrases like "gemini review", "ask gemini", or "gemini challenge" — or asks for a second opinion from Gemini. Especially useful for reviewing Google Ads changes, SEO metadata updates, and code changes.

say_en.text: Use gemini review on these Google Ads keyword changes.
say_en.note: Triggers review mode for a pass/fail verdict from Gemini.

say_en.text: Use gemini challenge to stress-test this SEO title change.
say_en.note: Triggers challenge mode to look for holes.

say_en.text: Ask gemini for advice on budget allocation for Google Ads.
say_en.note: Triggers consult mode to get Gemini's opinion.
